result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout/content truncation issue and one minor visual clipping concern.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row shows a truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' without an ellipsis, making it unclear the name is cut off. It reads as an incomplete word rather than a clearly truncated label.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis and overflow: hidden to restaurant name labels so truncated text ends with '…' (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…'), signaling to users that the name continues.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll list is partially clipped at the right edge of the screen with no visual affordance (e.g., a gradient fade or partial card peek) to clearly communicate horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge gradient overlay or ensure a consistent peek amount so users clearly understand the row is horizontally scrollable.
